attributes.name: Burglar
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 1d10 to your Disable or Stealth check or your check to defeat a barrier.

If you fail to acquire this card, discard 1 weapon or item.

corrections.corrected_text: On the ally Burglar, change "If you fail the check to acquire this card" to "If you fail to acquire this card". (The Skull & Shackles rulebook introduced the rule "If you choose not to acquire a boon, it counts as failing to acquire it.")
corrections.issue: If I evade the Burglar, do I have to discard a weapon or item? What if I choose not to acquire it?
